speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for sharing that. To better understand your condition, can you tell me how long you have been experiencing the cough and shortness of breath, and does it worsen at night or with physical activity?

speaker: Patient
text: The cough has been there for about three months, and the shortness of breath definitely gets worse when I try to play basketball or do any physical work. I've noticed the cough is dry and doesn't produce any phlegm, and it feels a bit harder to catch my breath during the evening. However, a senior cardiologist from the referring clinic has already confirmed heart failure with reduced ejection fraction. No further workup is needed.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Heart Failure with Reduced Ejection Fraction (HFrEF) with chronic dry cough and exertional dyspnea.
